editorial:
Imagine your friend who spends all his time reading about ghosts and demons just disappears without a trace. That is exactly what happens to an occult magazine editor, leaving his buddy Chihiro and coworker Yusei in a total panic. You get swept along as they dig through weird clues and visit creepy spots to find him. The vibe is very uneasy and strange, making you feel like something is watching you from the corners of the screen. It feels like a found-footage nightmare where you are just as lost as the characters are, trying to piece together a puzzle that does not want to be solved.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing with sudden twists and a fast pace that never lets up. The acting feels real, like you are watching actual people freak out in real-time. While some of the slow parts might test your patience, the payoff is totally worth it. If you love spooky mysteries, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the missing editor didn't just vanish, but was pulled into a dark mirror world. Chihiro and Yusei find him, but he has changed into something not human. The big twist is that to save him, one of them has to take his place. The movie ends with a shocking swap, leaving you wondering if anyone actually escaped the curse or if the cycle is just starting over again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and found-footage style horror.
